events.name: Texas Longhorns at Oklahoma Sooners

headlines.description: — Oklahoma and coach Brent Venables really needed this win. Getting it against top-ranked Texas in their Red River rivalry game and donning the Golden Hat trophy just made it that much better.
headlines.shortLinkText: Oklahoma upsets No. 1 Texas on Tate Sandell's game-ending 47-yard field goal

events.name: Georgia Bulldogs at Alabama Crimson Tide

headlines.description: — If Georgia lands the No. 1 ranking, it should probably come with an asterisk.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dwight Phillips Jr. and No. 2 Georgia run past No. 6 Alabama 20-17 in an SEC clash

events.name: Stanford Cardinal at Notre Dame Fighting Irish

headlines.description: — Freshman Jonaz Walton scored on a 97-yard run — the third longest offensive play in Notre Dame Stadium history — and finished with 181 yards as the No. 3 Fighting Irish routed Stanford 58-7 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: No. 3 Notre Dame uses big plays to rout Stanford 58-7 for its 16th straight victory

events.name: Maryland Terrapins at Ohio State Buckeyes

headlines.description: — His cheeks flushed the color of Ohio State's scarlet jerseys, coach Ryan Day didn't hold back from showing his frustration.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jeremiah Smith, Julian Sayin star as No. 5 Ohio State beats Maryland 45-16 before brutal stretch

events.name: Indiana Hoosiers at Nebraska Cornhuskers

headlines.description: — Josh Hoover surprised a Nebraska defense stacked to stop the run on a fourth-and-1, flipping the ball to a wide-open Nick Marsh for a 44-yard touchdown to give No. 7 Indiana its first lead in a 20-17 victory over Nebraska on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Hoover, Nick Marsh lead No. 7 Indiana to a 20-17 come-from-behind victory over Nebraska

events.name: Ole Miss Rebels at Vanderbilt Commodores

headlines.description: — Trinidad Chambliss threw for 213 yards and three touchdowns and ran for another score as ninth-ranked Mississippi routed Vanderbilt 52-17 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: No. 9 Ole Miss routs Vanderbilt 52-17 behind 4 combined TDs from Trinidad Chambliss

events.name: LSU Tigers at Kentucky Wildcats

headlines.description: — Quarterback Kenneth Minchey ran untouched for a 2-point conversion after C.J. Baxter scored on a 1-yard run to lift Kentucky to a 35-34 overtime victory over No. 10 LSU on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kentucky QB Minchey scores 2-point conversion in overtime to beat No. 10 LSU 35-34

events.name: Kansas Jayhawks at Utah Utes

headlines.description: — Wayshawn Parker ran for 171 yards and two touchdowns to lead No. 12 Utah to a 41-24 victory over Kansas on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wayshawn Parker runs for 171 yards and 2 TDs to lead No. 12 Utah past Kansas

events.name: UCLA Bruins at Oregon Ducks

headlines.description: — Wayne Knight rushed for a touchdown and caught another score, and No. 21 UCLA overcame an injury to starting quarterback Nico Iamaleava to remain undefeated with a 17-15 victory over No. 13 Oregon on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: No. 21 UCLA downs turnover-plagued No. 13 Oregon 17-15 to remain undefeated

events.name: Texas A&M Aggies at Missouri Tigers

headlines.description: — Jamal Roberts had 34 carries for a career-best 222 yards and two touchdowns, and Cayden Lee caught seven passes for 94 yards and a touchdown to help No. 14 Missouri beat Texas A&M 27-6 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jamal Roberts runs for 222 yards and 2 TDs to lead No. 14 Missouri past Texas A&M 27-6

events.name: Tennessee Volunteers at Arkansas Razorbacks

headlines.description: — George MacIntyre threw for 247 yards and a touchdown in his first career start, DeSean Bishop ran for 138 yards and No. 15 Tennessee rallied in the fourth quarter to beat Arkansas 24-17 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: No. 15 Tennessee rallies in 4th quarter to beat Arkansas 24-17

events.name: South Carolina Gamecocks at Florida Gators

headlines.description: — This was the kind of performance South Carolina expected from quarterback LaNorris Sellers all season.
headlines.shortLinkText: LaNorris Sellers shows up big, and South Carolina stuns No. 16 Florida 38-19 in the Swamp

events.name: UCF Knights at Oklahoma State Cowboys

headlines.description: — Drew Mestemaker threw for 304 yards and two touchdowns, Evan Jackson returned a fumble 28 yards for another score, and No. 18 Oklahoma State pulled away from UCF in the second half for a 42-28 win Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: No. 18 Oklahoma State surges past UCF 42-28 after a fumble-return turning point

events.name: USC Trojans at Penn State Nittany Lions

headlines.description: — Jayden Maiava completed 21 of 33 passes for 301 yards with three touchdowns and No. 19 USC outlasted Penn State 31- 23 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jayden Maiava leads No. 19 USC past Penn State 31-23

events.name: Houston Cougars at Kansas State Wildcats

headlines.description: — Conner Weigman and tight end Patrick Overmyer connected for four touchdown passes and No. 22 Houston beat Kansas State 35-16 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Weigman throws 4 TD passes to Overmyer in No. 22 Houston's 35-16 win over Kansas State

events.name: Boise State Broncos at Fresno State Bulldogs

headlines.description: — Dylan Riley ran for 150 yards and a touchdown on 19 carries and scored on a 44-yard catch-and-run to help No. 23 Boise State beat Fresno State 38-31 on Saturday night to end a three-game skid against the Bulldogs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dylan Riley leads No. 23 Boise State past Fresno State, 38-31

events.name: North Carolina Tar Heels at Pittsburgh Panthers

headlines.description: — Billy Edwards Jr. threw a 75-yard touchdown pass in the second half and North Carolina knocked off No. 25 Pittsburgh 21-17 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Billy Edwards Jr. helps UNC beat No. 25 Pitt 21-17, gives Belichick first win against a ranked foe

events.name: Arizona Wildcats at West Virginia Mountaineers

headlines.description: — Noah Fifita threw two of his three touchdown passes to Isaiah Mizell, Lee Molette III returned a fumble for a score and Arizona beat West Virginia 52-31 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Arizona dominates West Virginia 52-31 despite missing top 3 receivers with injuries

events.name: Wake Forest Demon Deacons at NC State Wolfpack
Tulane Green Wave at Army Black Knights

headlines.description: — Cale Hellums rushed for a career-high 223 yards, Dawson Jones kicked the winning field goal on the final play and Army edged Tulane 20-17 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cale Hellums runs for 223 yards, Dawson Jones delivers game-winner for Army in 20-17 win over Tulane

events.name: Sacramento State Hornets at Bowling Green Falcons

headlines.description: — Austyn Dendy rushed for 86 yards and two touchdowns as Bowling Green scored 38 straight points to beat Sacramento State 38-10 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dendy leads Bowling Green to first 2-0 MAC start since 2015 with 38-10 win over Sacramento State

events.name: Ball State Cardinals at Northwestern Wildcats

headlines.description: — Aidan Chiles passed for three touchdowns for the second time this season and ran for another as Northwestern routed Ball State 45-14 in a non-conference matchup on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Aidan Chiles throws for 3 TDs, runs for another: Northwestern rips Ball State 45-14

events.name: Rice Owls at East Carolina Pirates

headlines.description: — TJ Engleman Jr. ran for 136 yards that included 43-yard touchdown run in the fourth quarter to help East Carolina pull away and win its American Conference opener with a 28-12 victory over Rice on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Engleman's 43-yard TD run in 4th helps East Carolina beat Rice 28-12

events.name: Old Dominion Monarchs at App State Mountaineers

headlines.description: — Devin Roche rushed for 101 yards, and Maurki James scored the game’s only touchdown as Old Dominion beat Appalachian State 10-3 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Devin Roche, Maurki James help Old Dominion upset Appalachian State 10-3

events.name: Miami (OH) RedHawks at Massachusetts Minutemen

headlines.description: — Caleb Heavner and Scoop Smith each ran for touchdowns and Miami (Ohio) held on to beat UMass 20-19 in a contest that went down to the last offensive play of the game on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Miami (Ohio) holds firm, denying UMass 2-point conversion attempt in 20-19 win

events.name: Duke Blue Devils at Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets

headlines.description: — Trelain Maddox rushed for 81 yards and three touchdowns, including a go-ahead score from one yard out with 54 seconds remaining, leading Georgia Tech to a 28-25 upset victory over Duke at Bobby Dodd Stadium on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trelain Maddox's late TD, Duke missed FG gives Yellow Jackets first ACC win of season.

events.name: Virginia Tech Hokies at California Golden Bears

headlines.description: — Reserve running back Ashten Emory ran for two touchdowns and his 2-yard touchdown plunge with 18 seconds left capped Cal's 25-20 comeback win over Virginia Tech on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cal RB Ashten Emory scores 2 TDs in comeback win over Virginia Tech, 25-20

events.name: Illinois Fighting Illini at Michigan State Spartans

headlines.description: — Michael Clayton threw a 25-yard touchdown pass to Hudson Clement on the first play of overtime and Illinois made a stop on a 2-point conversion attempt to hold on for a 38-37 win...
headlines.shortLinkText: Illinois makes a stop on Michigan State's 2-point conversion attempt in OT, holds on for 38-37 win

events.name: Charlotte 49ers at North Texas Mean Green

headlines.description: — Tayven Jackson threw five touchdown passes, setting a personal best for the second consecutive game, and North Texas routed Charlotte 50-10 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tayven Jackson's 5 touchdown passes lead the way and North Texas routs Charlotte 50-10

events.name: Tulsa Golden Hurricane at Navy Midshipmen

headlines.description: — Quarterback Jackson Gutierrez ran for a career-high 232 yards and three touchdowns and threw for another score to lead Navy to a 34-26 victory over Tulsa on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Quarterback Gutierrez runs for 232 yards, accounts for 4 TDs in Navy's 34-26 win over Tulsa

events.name: Eastern Michigan Eagles at Akron Zips

headlines.description: — Rudy Kessinger made four field goals, including a 48-yarder with 1:50 remaining, and Noah Kim threw for 277 yards and a touchdown as Eastern Michigan rallied past Akron 25-23 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kessinger's 4 FGs, Kim's TD pass push Eastern Michigan over Akron 25-23

events.name: Buffalo Bulls at Toledo Rockets

headlines.description: — Messiah Burch broke loose on an 87-yard touchdown run with 4:30 remaining to help Buffalo pull away and beat Toledo 23-8 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Burch runs for 87-yard TD in the 4th to help Buffalo pull away for a 23-8 win over Toledo

events.name: Central Michigan Chippewas at Ohio Bobcats

headlines.description: — Nick Poulos threw three first-half touchdown passes and Ohio extended the nation's second longest current home winning streak to 16 with a 31-14 victory over Central Michigan on a rainy Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nick Poulos throws 3 TD passes, helps Ohio beat Central Michigan 31-14 for 16th straight win at home

events.name: Kent State Golden Flashes at Western Michigan Broncos

headlines.description: — Broc Lowry threw for 257 yards and three touchdowns and Western Michigan continued its mastery over Kent State with a 38-7 win on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lowry's 3TDs pace Western Michigan to another win over Kent State 38-7

events.name: UConn Huskies at Temple Owls

headlines.description: — Trey Cornist totaled 114 yards and one of Connecticut's four rushing touchdowns and the Huskies beat Temple 34-20 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trey Cornist rushes for 114 yards and a TD to power UConn to 34-20 victory over Temple

events.name: San Diego State Aztecs at Oregon State Beavers

headlines.description: — Braden Atkinson threw for 409 yards and tied his career high with five touchdown passes and Oregon State beat San Diego State 66-14 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Repeat performance: Atkinson again throws 5 TD passes in Oregon State's rout of San Diego State

events.name: UAB Blazers at Memphis Tigers

headlines.description: — Jaylin Carter ran for 132 yards and two touchdowns, and Memphis beat UAB 38-13 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carter, Memphis pull away from UAB in the 3rd, win 38-13

events.name: Nevada Wolf Pack at UTEP Miners

headlines.description: — Herschel Turner ran for a career-high 192 yards and his 72-yard touchdown burst broke the game open in the third quarter, leading Nevada to a 30-13 victory over UTEP on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Herschel Turner runs for 192 yards and Nevada dominates on defense in 30-13 win over UTEP

events.name: North Dakota State Bison at UNLV Rebels
Coastal Carolina Chanticleers at Marshall Thundering Herd

headlines.description: — Dominic Lee-Knicely rushed for 169 yards and a touchdown, and Coastal Carolina held on to beat Marshall 27-21 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dominic Lee-Knicely powers Coastal Carolina over Marshall 27-21

events.name: Syracuse Orange at Virginia Cavaliers

headlines.description: — Jekail Middlebrook rushed for two touchdowns in the fourth quarter, and Virginia overcame a 10-point second-half deficit to beat Syracuse 28-25 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Middlebrook's 2 rushing TDs help Virginia overcome 10-point deficit, beat Syracuse 28-24

events.name: Air Force Falcons at Northern Illinois Huskies

headlines.description: — Evan Medders and Owen Allen combined for more than 200 yards rushing and four scores for Air Force, and the Falcons beat Northern Illinois 28-7 on Saturday night in the Mountain West Conference inaugural for the Huskies.
headlines.shortLinkText: Air Force does not complete a pass, beats Northern Illinois in the Huskies' first Mountain West game

events.name: Louisiana Ragin' Cajuns at Louisiana Tech Bulldogs

headlines.description: — Blake Baker threw three touchdown passes and ran for another score, and Louisiana Tech scored 19 points in the fourth quarter to beat Louisiana-Lafayette 32-31 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Louisiana Tech beats Louisiana-Lafayette 32-31 after 19-point 4th quarter

events.name: Minnesota Golden Gophers at Purdue Boilermakers

headlines.shortLinkText: Fame Ijeboi powers Purdue past Minnesota, 41-13

events.name: James Madison Dukes at Georgia Southern Eagles

headlines.description: — Camden Coleman threw for 171 yards and a touchdown, reserve quarterback JC Evans threw for two touchdowns and James Madison became bowl eligible with a 27-24 win over Georgia Southern on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Coleman, Evans lead James Madison to bowl eligibility with 27-24 win over Georgia Southern

events.name: Hawai'i Rainbow Warriors at Arizona State Sun Devils

headlines.description: — Cardae Mack ran for 154 yards and two scores, Cutter Boley threw two touchdown passes to Reed Harris and Arizona State grinded out a 30-12 win over Hawaii on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cardae Mack runs for 154 yards and 2 touchdowns, Arizona State grinds out 30-12- win over Hawaii
